description: Which of the traveler's bank points can become miles/points in a target loyalty program, at what ratio, and how many they would end up with. Also returns the transfer bonuses running now for those banks, with the bonus %, the ratio with the bonus and the end date (active_bonus on each path, active_bonuses_for_your_banks for every partner), so it answers "is there a transfer bonus right now and when does it end". Ratios come from a researched table, each bank dated by when it was checked (checked on each path; as_of_by_bank); ratios change. Pass the traveler's balances (any amount, e.g. 0, to ask about a ratio or bonus). Miles are whole partner points (floor of points x ratio), in the partner's minimum and steps where known, with what is left over. Where the ratio depends on the card, pass the cards they named or the wallet holds (cards): each path says which card its ratio is for (ratio_card, card_ratios). Partners a bank dropped come back in no_longer_partners with the date.

balances.description: The traveler's bank point balances, e.g. [{"bank":"amex_mr","points":250000}]. amex_mr means a US-issued Amex; for an Amex issued elsewhere use the country key (amex_mr_be/_nl/_uk/_fr/_de/_es/_it/_se/_ch/_ca/_au/_sg/_hk/_in/_ae: different partners and ratios). Also Revolut RevPoints (revolut_eu, revolut_uk) and local banks (rbc_avion_ca, anz_au, westpac_au, nab_au, cba_au, dbs_sg, uob_sg, citi_sg, hsbc_sg, hsbc_hk, citi_hk, scb_hk, hdfc_in, axis_in, icici_in, enbd_ae, mashreq_ae, fab_ae). Ask which country issued the card if unclear.

cards.description: Cards the traveller named or the wallet holds, e.g. ["Sapphire Preferred"], ["HDFC Regalia Gold"], ["Axis Magnus"], or wallet slugs like "chase_sapphire_reserve". Some partners have a ratio per card; empty if unknown.

miles_needed.description: Miles the award costs, to check whether the balances cover it; null if unknown

target_programs.description: Program slugs, e.g. ["aeroplan","flyingblue","virginatlantic","ana","hyatt"]. Empty array or omitted = list every partner reachable from the balances.
